tools.name: kpop_search
tools.description: Free. Search K-pop / pop concerts in Korea for the next 6 months by artist or title (any language). Returns concert ids.

tools.name: seoul_places
tools.description: Free. The 121 Seoul places (with codes) accepted by seoul_now.

tools.name: request_korea_data
tools.description: Free. Ask for Korea data these tools don't cover yet; the most requested is added first.

tools.name: incheon_airport_wait
tools.description: Live Incheon Airport departure-hall waiting minutes and queue per hall (T1/T2) and the shortest hall. 10 free calls/day.

tools.name: seoul_subway_now
tools.description: Next trains at a Seoul subway station right now (station in English, Japanese or Korean). 10 free calls/day.

tools.name: seoul_now
tools.description: Live crowd level, 12-hour crowd forecast and weather for a Seoul place (e.g. Myeongdong, Hongdae). 10 free calls/day.

tools.name: kpop_new_concerts
tools.description: Concerts in Korea newly registered or updated since a date (YYYYMMDD, default 7 days), optional artist. 10 free calls/day.

tools.name: korea_festivals
tools.description: Festivals and events in Korea from a date (YYYYMMDD). 10 free calls/day.

tools.name: seoul_trip_pack
tools.description: Seoul concert trip pack (tickets, venue, last trains, crowd, hotels/food nearby) — paid only: returns how to buy it.
